verdicts.labelEn: Android pro-audio maximum round-trip audio latency (analog path)

verdicts.conditionsEn: Android 16 CDD certification requirement: handheld declaring FEATURE_AUDIO_PRO, round-trip latency ≤ 20 ms (MAD ≤ 5 ms) on the analog 3.5 mm loopback if supported; upper bound, not a measurement.
verdicts.notes: Table marked 'Start of requirements changed in Android 16'.

verdicts.conditionsEn: Android 16 CDD certification requirement: handheld declaring FEATURE_AUDIO_LOW_LATENCY, round-trip latency ≤ 50 ms (MAD ≤ 10 ms) on at least one loopback path; upper bound, not a measurement.

verdicts.evidence: CDD 5.4.2 [C-1-1]: 'MUST capture ... VOICE_RECOGNITION audio source at one of the sampling rates, 44100 and 48000.' 5.4.1 raw capture MUST support 8000, 11025, 16000, 44100, 48000 Hz.

fix.conditions: Sampling rate named in the Android 16 CDD: voice-recognition capture must use 44100 or 48000 Hz (5.4.2 [C-1-1]); raw capture must support 8000, 11025, 16000, 44100 and 48000 Hz (5.4.1). The CDD does not call it a 'standard PCM rate'.

verdicts.labelFr: Fréquence d'échantillonnage audio de 44,1 kHz
verdicts.labelEn: Audio sampling rate 44.1 kHz
verdicts.conditionsFr: Fréquence d'échantillonnage citée par la CDD d'Android 16 : la capture pour la reconnaissance vocale doit se faire à 44 100 ou 48 000 Hz.
verdicts.conditionsEn: Sampling rate named in the Android 16 CDD: voice-recognition capture must use 44100 or 48000 Hz.
verdicts.notes: Value and quote correct; 'standard PCM rate' is a characterisation not made by the source.

verdicts.evidence: CDD 5.4.2 [C-1-1]: '... at one of the sampling rates, 44100 and 48000.' 7.8.4 glitch-test table lists NONE/SHARED at 48000, 44100, 16000.

fix.conditions: Sampling rate named in the Android 16 CDD: voice-recognition capture must use 44100 or 48000 Hz (5.4.2 [C-1-1]). The AAudio table cited is the 7.8.4 glitch-test combination list (SHOULD), not a stream-rate requirement.

verdicts.labelFr: Fréquence d'échantillonnage audio de 48 kHz
verdicts.labelEn: Audio sampling rate 48 kHz
verdicts.conditionsFr: Fréquence d'échantillonnage citée par la CDD d'Android 16 : la capture pour la reconnaissance vocale doit se faire à 44 100 ou 48 000 Hz.
verdicts.conditionsEn: Sampling rate named in the Android 16 CDD: voice-recognition capture must use 44100 or 48000 Hz.
verdicts.notes: The 'only shared-mode rate above 44.1 kHz' remark refers to a SHOULD-level glitch-test list in 7.8.4; reworded.
